## About
Wong's Performance Engineering is a GM-dedicated, high-performance tuning center serving Portland and Vancouver. We diagnose, repair and tune engine control systems, including the complex ones.
Customers tell us they come here for the knowledge and the communication. Corvette owners find their way to us, and our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 78 Google reviews.

## Services
- Dyno tune: A quality dyno tune for modified engines. One reviewer said he took his time on the job.
- Engine control system repair: We diagnose, repair and tune engine control systems, even the most complex ones.
- ECM/PCM VATS bypass: Help with a VATS bypass for passlock issues. One reviewer had this done on a Chevy Suburban.

## FAQ
Q: What kind of cars do you work on?
A: We are a GM-dedicated, high-performance tuning center.

Q: How long does a tune take?
A: It depends on the car. One reviewer said it took about 3 hours.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on weekends.
